newsitem.title: USA: Columbus Realty adopts rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Columbus Realty adopts rights plan.

text.p: Columbus Realty Trust said on Tuesday that it has adopted a shareholder rights plan and declared a distribution of one preferred share purchase right for each outstanding common share of Columbus.
The preferred share purchase rights are issuable on June 12, 1997, to each shareholder of record on June 9, 1997.
Columbus Realty also said it had acquired two sites for the development of approximately 282 multifamily units near the central business district of Dallas.
Columbus has acquired 2.76 acres in Dallas upon which it plans to construct approximately 200 units, it said.

The property is located on Clyde Lane at the corner of McKinney and Oak Grove in the uptown district of Dallas, adjacent to the existing 1,647 completed units owned and managed by the company, the company said.

Also, Columbus said it has recently acquired the American Beauty Mill property located at 2400 South Ervay, south of downtown Dallas where it plans to convert the historic former flour mill to 82 loft units at a cost of approximately $5.0 million.
